paragraphs.text: The Maumiwu Wastes (mah-mee-vu ) are part of Jamuraa on Dominaria.

The Wastes are the barren lands between the northern and southern parts of the western continent. To the northeast lies the Great Desert , to the west the Karoo , and to the south Amrou Haven and Arboria .
The wastes' name is derived from Swahili maumivu , meaning "pain".
